funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed.
opportunities.summary: Flexible support for organisations undertaking ambitious and sustained research in British art, with public‑facing outcomes such as exhibitions, digital projects or catalogues.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Exhibition Publication Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or non‑profit; exhibition may be forthcoming or already held.
opportunities.summary: Supports organisations to produce publications related to their exhibitions, helping disseminate new research on British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Event Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed.
opportunities.summary: Supports organisations to disseminate research through live, online or hybrid events for diverse audiences.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking conservation research on publicly owned collections.
opportunities.summary: Supports vital conservation research on significant works of British art, covering staff and equipment costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Digitisation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking digitisation of their own British art collections.
opportunities.summary: Provides financial support for organisations to make collections freely available online via digitisation.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to individuals at any career stage who have a confirmed publisher and a publication date within three years.
opportunities.summary: Provides financial support for authors to publish monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles on British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals at any career stage; higher tiers require post‑doctoral experience.
opportunities.summary: Flexible funding for individuals to undertake research travel and/or research time in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Study Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: For individuals enrolled in or about to start a master's or doctoral degree in British art, visual culture or architecture.
opportunities.summary: Fixed‑amount support to help students begin or continue postgraduate study in British art related fields.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Andrew Wyld Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered students (undergraduate level and above) researching 18th‑19th‑century British works on paper.
opportunities.summary: Supports travel and related costs for students to examine prints, drawings and watercolours in person.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer for a UK‑based master’s degree (MA, MPhil, MSc or equivalent) starting between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support a master’s degree that will bring new perspectives to British art studies.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship

amount.raw: £96,000 total (£32,000 per year for three years)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer for a UK‑based doctorate starting between April 2027 and April 2028; post‑doctoral level not required.
opportunities.summary: Provides full tuition and living‑expense support for a doctoral research project in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Early Career Fellowship

amount.raw: £35,000 per year (one‑year) or £70,000 for two years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Post‑doctoral level individuals (or equivalent experience) seeking to undertake a major research project.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support an in‑depth research project that will reshape understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Rome Fellowship

amount.raw: Full board, accommodation and honorarium for a three‑month stay

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scholars, researchers, curators, archivists and GLAM professionals (pre‑doctoral to internationally recognised) with at least a first degree.
opportunities.summary: Three‑month residency at the British School at Rome for advanced research on British‑Italian cultural exchange.
